name: Spanish Co-driver Voice (Copiloto en español)
author: RamiroRP
tag_line: Spanish (es-ES) co-driver voice for BeamNG's rally mode: every pacenote called in Spanish
description: A complete Spanish (Spain) co-driver voice for BeamNG's rally mode. All 180 pacenote audio files of the game's co-driver (turns, distances, crests, jumps, cautions...) are spoken in Spanish with a neural voice (Piper, es_ES-davefx-medium, CC0 dataset). Install the zip in mods/, then pick 'Copiloto en español (Piper)' in the rally co-driver options. Works with the vanilla rally mode and with Raid.Earth.
